description: A young man in ornate gold-and-crimson embroidered robes and a tall jeweled headdress raises one hand in front of a large black conical stone on a gold chariot pulled by black horses. Behind him, armoured Roman soldiers with spears and a crested helmet stand near burning torches, with eagle standards, smoke, fire and classical stone buildings in the background. No visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
